Company Description

Tremend is the newest global software engineering hub for Publicis Sapient. For over 20 years, the company has been infusing its advanced technical expertise into complex and innovative solutions that meet today's digital transformation needs and pave the way for a better and smarter future. By joining forces with Publicis Sapient we're accelerating the impact, providing a good mix of talented engineers, technology, continuous improvement, innovation, and R&D. Here, you'll have the opportunity to unleash your potential, powering up advanced software solutions for some of the world's most iconic brands. Embrace your passion for technology, creativity, and continuous improvement, and join us in making a difference through engineering.

Overview

Experienced Murex Control-M Developer with strong expertise in scheduling, automation, and batch processing within the Murex MX.3 environment. Skilled in designing, implementing, and supporting automated workflows for Front Office, Middle Office, and Back Office processes, ensuring reliable end-of-day (EOD), start-of-day (SOD), and intraday operations across financial trading environments. 

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Design, develop, and maintain Control-M job scheduling solutions supporting Murex MX.3 environments. 
  • Develop and manage automated batch processes for End-of-Day (EOD), Start-of-Day (SOD), market data loading, valuation, and reporting. 
  • Configure and maintain job dependencies, calendars, alerts, notifications, and recovery procedures. 
  • Monitor daily production schedules and resolve batch failures to ensure timely business processing. 
  • Work closely with Murex functional teams, infrastructure, and application support teams to optimize scheduling processes. 
  • Implement and support file transfers, interface automation, and integration with upstream and downstream systems. 
  • Perform root cause analysis of scheduling issues and implement preventive improvements. 
  • Support production releases, deployments, and migration of Control-M jobs across environments. 
  • Develop operational documentation, scheduling procedures, and disaster recovery processes. 
  • Participate in production support and provide on-call support for critical batch processing. 

 

 

Qualifications:

 

  • Control-M Scheduler (BMC) 
  • Murex MX.3 Batch Processing 
  • Unix/Linux Shell Scripting 
  • Oracle SQL 
  • Job Scheduling & Workflow Automation 
  • File Transfer Automation (FTP/SFTP) 
  • Production Support & Incident Management 
  • Monitoring & Alert Configuration 
  • Autosys / Enterprise Scheduling (desirable) 
  • Agile/Scrum, JIRA, Confluence 
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills

Additional Information

Besides an exciting job in a tremendous team, here's what you can expect:

  • A fast-paced tech environment
  • Continuous growth & learning
  • Open feedback culture
  • Room for own initiative & ideas
  • Transparency about results & strategy
  • Recognition & reward for hard work
  • Working with a flexible schedule 
  • Medical subscription
  • Meal tickets
  • Extra vacation days - starting with 25 vacation days
  • Many others perks
